scene_description: Two children, a boy and a girl, are riding an amusement park ride, possibly a roller coaster, and appear to be laughing and having fun. A Ferris wheel and other rides are visible in the background.

questions.question: What do you think the children will do after their ride is over?
What do you think the children did right before they got on this ride?
Have you ever been on a fun ride like this? What was your favorite part?
What other kind of ride do you think the children might want to go on at the amusement park?
questions.evidence_hint: Imagine a different ride they could choose.

questions.question: Why do you think the children are laughing and smiling so much on the ride?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at their faces and imagine how they feel.
